project.title: An Evidence and Estimand Audit of a Paired Fixed-Filler Record

review_config.minimum_meaningful_improvement: one official rating step or an objective critical/major issue reduction

blockers: Experimental records A32-E1 and A32-E2, the stable ID crosswalk, preregistration, item-level traces, implementation, environment lock, and table reproducer were not located.

The literal filler, insertion location, tokenizer-level dose verification, 400-item sampling rule/manifest, sample overlap, prompt serialization, arm construction, and score aggregation are unavailable.
Decoder determinism or multi-seed variability cannot be verified; the retained estimand is conditional on one recorded decode realization.
The commit score is not validated as a probability of final-answer correctness; source-labelled Brier/NLL measurements were therefore removed.
Uncertainty inputs, targets, and code are absent; no bracket, interval, or coverage claim is retained.
MATH500 judge, sample, and correction artifacts are absent; its numerical scenario was removed.
Citation verification is complete only for the subset recorded in citation_lock.json; a broader prompt-length and masked-diffusion uncertainty audit remains incomplete.
